# ⚙️ 9. ChatGPT Reuse Instructions  
*(This section tells ChatGPT what to do automatically whenever you upload new problems.)*

> **When I upload problem images, do ALL of the following automatically:**
> 1. Transcribe the problem into clean LaTeX.

> 7. Do **NOT** rely on previous problems — treat each new upload independently.
> 8. If multiple problems are uploaded, repeat the entire template for each problem.
> 9. Maintain consistent numbering and formatting.
